scope: Offline spot research only, same frozen 1h and 5m price source as v2

exit_policy.bullish: Profit >=1% net AND latest known 1h DI+ >50 arms 0.5% highest-since-entry trail
exit_policy.protection: 0.5% intended net loss budget; literal 0.5% price-stop sensitivity
exit_policy.regime: Latest closed 1h Section5 REGIME; entry-frozen sensitivity

features_frozen_before_evaluation.range_boundary: High/low of previous 12 completed 5m bars, excluding current
features_frozen_before_evaluation.micro_boundary: High of previous 3 completed 5m bars, excluding current
features_frozen_before_evaluation.relative_volume: Current completed 5m base volume / mean previous 20 completed 5m base volumes
features_frozen_before_evaluation.volume_breakout: Close above prior-12 high; bullish close in upper 30%; TR >=1.2 prior ATR; RVOL >=1.5
features_frozen_before_evaluation.volume_breakdown: Close below prior-12 low; bearish close in lower 30%; TR >=1.5 prior ATR; RVOL >=1.5
features_frozen_before_evaluation.rapid_breakdown_crash: Volume breakdown plus <=-0.5% close-to-close in 5m or <=-1% in 15m
features_frozen_before_evaluation.crash_recent: Crash confirmed now or within previous 3 bars (15m)
features_frozen_before_evaluation.crash_unrecovered: Crash within last 12 bars (1h), and no completed close above its recorded high
features_frozen_before_evaluation.micro_reclaim: Close above prior-3 high, bullish body, upper 40% close
features_frozen_before_evaluation.range_low_reclaim: Low below prior-12 low, close back above that known low, upper 35% close, RVOL >=1.2
features_frozen_before_evaluation.breakout_retest: Within 6 bars after volume breakout, low touches known breakout level within 0.05%, closes above level in upper 40%, and no fresh crash
features_frozen_before_evaluation.pending_di_setup: Wait at most 6 additional completed bars (30m) for price confirmation; new rapid breakdown cancels pending entry

tests: same entry / old bearish trailing vs new bearish fixed TP
bullish volume-breakout branch without oversold DI entry gate
bullish breakout-retest branch without oversold DI entry gate

validation.chronological_check: 2025-2026; already viewed history, not prospective validation
validation.candidate_screen: Require >=50 discovery trades, discovery mean net >0 and PF>1 before considering a general-use gate; report all candidates even when failing
validation.no_optimization: One predefined feature setting per rule; no threshold grid search
